conflicts.resolution: Keep phase-specific platform IDs and route records. Platform classification is mandatory.

conflicts.finding: The Duster OBDb enhanced corpus contains useful request headers and DIDs but several records omit explicit response addresses.

conflicts.resolution: Use platform_known_route_knowledge_incomplete terminal state; never inherit Zoe routes.
